Reviewer dimension: QUAL
Paper summary: The paper proposes Prototypical Networks, a metric learning approach for few-shot classification that represents each class by the mean of its support set embeddings (prototypes) and classifies queries via softmax over Euclidean distances to these prototypes. The method is trained using episodic training to mimic the few-shot test setting. The authors demonstrate the method's effectiveness on Omniglot and miniImageNet for few-shot learning and on CUB-200 for zero-shot learning, claiming competitive or state-of-the-art performance with a simpler and more scalable architecture compared to matching networks.

Dimension score (1-10): 7
Confidence (1-5): 4
